name: Fresh Canna Live Resin | OG Kush
description: Experience the legendary potency and classic flavor of Fresh Canna’s Live Resin Wax – OG Kush, a true West Coast icon known for its heavy-hitting effects and rich terpene profile. Crafted from fresh-frozen cannabis, this premium live resin wax delivers a full-spectrum, flavorful, and ultra-smooth dabbing experience. With earthy pine, zesty lemon, and a hint of spicy fuel, OG Kush brings a balanced yet powerful high, starting with an uplifting cerebral rush before settling into deep body relaxation. Perfect for stress relief, mood elevation, and kicking back after a long day, this legendary strain remains a go-to for seasoned smokers and new consumers alike.
